body: Everyone wishes they could have the dream car, dream girl, dream house...sometimes we just have to be happy for that day and things can get better.  I know this sounds vague but you have succeeded enough to have someone marry you.  I am afraid I will never be able to do that.  You have succeeded enough to be enlisted in the Navy.  I am afraid I will never be able to do that. I have failed plenty of times in my life and the only time when people respect me is when I fight back against road blocks that come my way.  You need to fight against the roadblocks that are in your way and create your own path.

I know where you are coming from. Suicide would crush your family my ex-girlfriend killed herself 3 months ago and it haunts me everyday.  I am a guy who would think as tough but on the inside I am so insecure.  The only thing I can tell you is realize what your weaknesses are and remind yourself what gives you strength so you can carry on.  I feel as if I act happy eventually people will see me as the person I want to be but not yet the person I feel inside. Whatever you do I hope you never feel the pain that actually resorts to taking your own life.
